name: witness
description: Capture-time evidence for photos, anchored on Portaldot V3.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @witness/core -w @witness/sdk && npm run build -w @witness/notary -w @witness/tools && npm run build -w @witness/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.deploy:registry: npm run build:packages && npm run deploy:registry -w @witness/tools
scripts.verify:live: npm run build:packages && npm run verify:live -w @witness/tools
